# E0305: a lens writes a field its target schema does not declare

A lens writes only fields its target schema declares, however open the author
wrote the schema: a lens is bound to the schema as declared. A field written
under a condition counts; it exists once data makes the condition true. Hidden
fields the target does not declare are the lens's own scratch space and are
not checked.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a:  string
				b?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.1->0.0": {
		v0_1: _
		v0_0: {
			a: v0_1.a
			if v0_1.a == "boom" {
				extra: 1
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0305]: the result of lens 0.1->0.0 writes extra, which schema 0.0 does not declare
  --> lineage.cue:20:3
   |
20 |         v0_0: {
   |         ^^^^
   |
   = help: a lens writes only fields its target schema declares, however open the schema is written
```
